top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Treasury Rally Sputters on Oil Jump: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rally in bonds fizzled out and stocks fell on bets the Treasury plan to curb borrowing costs is just a short-term fix, with a renewed surge in oil prices stoking worries about inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Fall as Oil, Yields Climb While Walmart Slumps
top_signals.summary: US stocks slid at the open on Thursday as a rally in government bonds sputtered, sending yields higher, and oil prices rose. Walmart Inc.’s earnings disappointed, pressuring shares of the retail giant and peers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Fed Policy Is in a Good Place, Daly Says
top_signals.summary: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly reacts to the recent selloff in bonds and suggests the US Treasury market is signaling that monetary policy is in a good place. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: MiCA cracks down on USDT in Europe... but no one else cares
top_signals.summary: USDT is disappearing from regulated European platforms, but there is little sign that it has resulted in weakening global demand for Tether.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
